metrics.name: Detection precision
metrics.description: This ratio measures supported error assertions among all distinct error assertions.
metrics.inputs: See the symbol table in docs/scoring-v1.md.
metrics.aggregation: Pool raw decisions and calculate the ratio again. Do not average percentages.

metrics.name: Detection recall
metrics.description: This ratio measures the true detection units that the teacher found.
metrics.inputs: See the symbol table in docs/scoring-v1.md.
metrics.aggregation: Pool raw decisions and calculate the ratio again. Do not average percentages.

metrics.name: Detection F1
metrics.description: This ratio combines detection precision and recall. If true opportunities exist and the teacher finds none, its value is zero.
metrics.inputs: See the symbol table in docs/scoring-v1.md.
metrics.aggregation: Pool raw decisions and calculate the ratio again. Do not average percentages.

metrics.name: Miss rate

metrics.inputs: See the symbol table in docs/scoring-v1.md.
metrics.aggregation: Pool raw decisions and calculate the ratio again. Do not average percentages.

metrics.name: False discovery rate

metrics.inputs: See the symbol table in docs/scoring-v1.md.
metrics.aggregation: Pool raw decisions and calculate the ratio again. Do not average percentages.

metrics.aggregation: Pool raw decisions and calculate the ratio again. Do not average percentages.

metrics.aggregation: Pool raw decisions and calculate the ratio again. Do not average percentages.

metrics.aggregation: Pool raw decisions and calculate the ratio again. Do not average percentages.

metrics.aggregation: Pool raw decisions and calculate the ratio again. Do not average percentages.

metrics.aggregation: Pool raw decisions and calculate the ratio again. Do not average percentages.

auxiliary_metrics.name: Raw inter-rater agreement
auxiliary_metrics.description: Compare the same nominal labels before adjudication. If no labeled units exist, the result is null.

auxiliary_metrics.name: Cohen kappa
auxiliary_metrics.description: Use two independent raters before adjudication. Report the label counts and marginal proportions. If N is zero or Pe equals one, return null.

auxiliary_metrics.name: Unconstrained transcript word error rate
auxiliary_metrics.description: Compare the approved surface transcript with raw ASR text through unit-cost Levenshtein distance. WER does not establish pronunciation.

auxiliary_metrics.name: Speech rate WPM
auxiliary_metrics.description: Measure the interval from the first spoken token to the last spoken token. Include internal pauses.

auxiliary_metrics.name: Articulation rate WPM
auxiliary_metrics.description: Use reviewed speech intervals only. Record the VAD method separately. This measure is not elapsed speech rate.

auxiliary_metrics.name: Internal pause ratio
auxiliary_metrics.description: Use the declared silence detector and its version. Identify intended pauses separately.

auxiliary_metrics.name: Disfluencies per 100 words
auxiliary_metrics.description: Count only reviewed events. An ordinary filler is not automatically an error.

auxiliary_metrics.name: Semantic decision coverage
auxiliary_metrics.description: Report this ratio beside mapping precision. Abstention must not hide low coverage.

auxiliary_metrics.name: Mapping agreement with adjudicated gold
auxiliary_metrics.description: Compare exact claim-to-unit decisions with adjudicated gold. Count wrong mappings and abstentions as disagreement.

auxiliary_metrics.name: Elapsed attempt wall time
auxiliary_metrics.description: Measure elapsed wall time only. Idle time does not measure teaching ability.

auxiliary_metrics.name: Audio play-event count
auxiliary_metrics.description: Count accepted playback events only. Client events do not prove that the teacher listened.

auxiliary_metrics.name: Teacher talk time
auxiliary_metrics.description: This mode does not observe teacher speech duration. The value is null.

auxiliary_metrics.description: This mode does not observe teacher pronunciation. The value is null.
